question: By what means can a mind fixed on that remain uncut even when the body is being severed?
premises: A body may be in the process of being cut apart.
A mind fixed on that object differs from the body being cut.
That fixedness of mind prevents the cutting from affecting it.
inference: What is fixed on that remains uncut in the same measure as the cutting acts only on what differs from it.
uncertainties: Extent of separation between mind and body remains implicit.
plain_english: Even as the body is being cut, one whose mind is fixed on that is not cut, just so.
